Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 ORDER
This petition is filed seeking for a writ of habeas corpus for production of the corpus who is said to be the sister of the petitioner.
On notice being issued, the State have filed reply along with various documents.
The corpus is produced through Mr. Brij Mohan Kushwah, T.I., Mr. Anil Kumar Kanoujiya Head Constable No.951 and Ms. Pooja Patel, Lady Constable No.1171 of Police Station Gourjhamar District Sagar.
She has been brought from her maternal-grand-mother's house.
We have interacted with her.
She has also recorded the statement before the Police which she reiterates before us.
She states that she was forcibly married to one Devendra Ahirwar by her parents.
That she does not intend to stay with him.
That she finds herself to be in safe custody if she stays along with her maternal uncle Dilip Ahirwar and maternal aunt Smt. Ruprani Ahirwar.
That they stay at village Gujwara, Police Station Gaurjhamar District Sagar.
The petitioner who is the brother of the corpus submits that he is also staying with them.

Learned counsel for the State submits that the parents of the corpus along with Devendra Ahirwar and relatives have been arrested for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 109 of the IPC,
Section 9, 10 and 11 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 and Sections 3/4,17 of the POCSO Act.

On interacting with the corpus as well as the submission made by the petitioner who is the brother of the corpus, prima facie we are satisfied that in her best interest it would be appropriate if she remains in the custody of her maternal uncle and aunt.
Hence, it is directed that she be handed over to the custody of her maternal uncle.
The petition is disposed off.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (VISHAL MISHRA)
 CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE  MSP Akash Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102444922/
